environment.runner: local Python stdlib unittest + real loopback HTTP

red_pre_patch.reason: POST /reset was accepted during a pending synthetic POST /submit, allowing delayed prior work to cross a trial reset boundary

behavior: Reject HTTP reset with 409 while a request is already registered as in-flight, before dispatch or while ACK is delayed; after completion reconcile and reset explicitly.
limitations: The reset gate does not recognize requests still queued before the HTTP handler begins; it is not a complete cross-trial quiescence proof.
It cannot independently attest CUA/Pomerado route execution, external user authorization, or outcome truth.
The full experiment packet with the updated 94-test minimum was not run locally; GitHub CI/Boat/Avrea remain separately unverified.
The runner must still reconcile uncertain writes independently, stop all prior clients, and never blind-retry.
contributor_credit: Original CUA authors retain credit; external Pomerado (MIT, Pomerado AI, Inc.) was not modified or contacted.
